implementation.name: 1943 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 109 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 100 verilog, 8 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this core predates the MRA format and ships no .mra file, but its ROM recipe names the MAME set outright -- https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-1943_MiSTer/blob/master/_releases/build_rom.ini reads zip=1943u.zip (the 1943 world-set line above it is commented out). That is the same fact an MRA <setname> carries, read from a different file, and MAME's own cloneof relation resolves it to parent machine_id 1943. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-1943_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-1943_MiSTer/blob/master/jt_gng/1943/hdl/jt1943_char.v reads "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: 100 of 109 HDL files are verilog (1 systemverilog, 100 verilog, 8 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
